description: Display ad request / response volume and response rate for a marketplace over a period, grouped by any combination of the dimensions below: supply network, page type, device, ad unit, product category (L1-L3), hour of day, or the keyword the request carried. Replaces the six single-grain Display RR reports. Group by page_type for page-type RR, by hour for the hourly RR curve, by ad_unit to find ad units with zero responses, by keyword for keyword-level Display RR, or by keyword + ad_unit for the follow-up breakdown. Pass a NOT IN ('', 'NA') filter on the grouping column to reproduce the null/blank guards the retired reports hardcoded.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.responses ELSE 0 END), 0)

response_rate.selector: SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0))

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.os_display_ads_filtered_level_performance_facts AS r JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
